question: Who will win the international friendly match between India vs Brazil on 3rd October?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "India": Wins if India score more goals than Brazil at the end of 90 minutes of regular time (plus any referee-added stoppage time) in the international friendly match played on October 3, 2026, at Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan, Kolkata.
- "Brazil": Wins if Brazil score more goals than India at the end of 90 minutes of regular time (plus any referee-added stoppage time) in the same match.
- "Draw": Wins if both teams have scored an equal number of goals at the end of 90 minutes of regular time (plus any referee-added stoppage time) in the same match.

Clarifications:
- Settlement is based on the scoreline at the end of regulation time (90 minutes plus stoppage time) only; any extra time or penalty shootout, if played, is not considered.
- If the match is cancelled, postponed beyond the market's settlement time, or abandoned before a full result is officially declared, refer to the platform's standard no-result policy.
